invariant: A valid package or symbol-container opening line is one atomic ownership event, but the identity and stereotype metadata are determined by the first registered Java command whose complete-line grammar matches. In class diagrams CommandPackage is registered before CommandPackageWithUSymbol, so a `package` line first uses CommandPackage's NAME, optional immediate `as AS`, then one trailing StereotypePattern capture. If a stereotype appears between NAME and `as`, the optional AS clause cannot match; the permissive trailing stereotype capture may instead absorb that text through the last `>>`, the Quark identity remains NAME, and StereotypeDecoration#cutLabels extracts every chevron label from the captured blob. Non-package symbol keywords use CommandPackageWithUSymbol. Its quoted-display and unquoted identity alternatives allow an identity-slot stereotype before `as`, followed by a distinct trailing STEREOTYPE capture. executeArg calls RegexResult#getLazzy rather than concatenating slots: observed Java behavior is that a populated trailing STEREOTYPE is the stored visible stereotype; otherwise the populated identity-slot capture supplies it. Once a command matches, it resolves one Quark, CucaDiagram#gotoGroup creates or reuses the Entity on that Quark, and that same group becomes current scope until the matching brace. Quark.parent remains the sole ownership identity consumed by Entity#getParentContainer and SVEK cluster traversal. A malformed package-shaped opening line matches no Java command and yields a syntax error; it must never be treated as an ignorable unknown line whose children leak into the surrounding scope.
causal_divergence: The first Rust repair widened one unified ClassParser#try_package regex and concatenated identity-slot and trailing-slot stereotypes. That repaired the narrow original case where a valid trailing sequence of two stereotypes was rejected and the owner vanished, but it erased Java's command precedence and slot ownership. For `cloud "Split Explicit" <<North>> <<South>> as SplitExplicit ... <<East>>`, Java uses CommandPackageWithUSymbol and stores only the trailing <<East>> capture, while Rust concatenates North, South, and East. For `package "Split Fallback" <<PreOne>> as SplitFallback ... <<PostTwo>> <<PostThree>>`, Java first matches ordinary CommandPackage: the intervening stereotype prevents its optional immediate AS clause, NAME remains the Quark identity, and its single permissive trailing capture spans all three chevron labels plus the intervening text. Rust instead takes SplitFallback as an alias and changes the ownership path. Finally, parse_line still silently ignores a package-shaped line when modifier parsing fails. The malformed `<<PostTwo>` negative control therefore drops the opener and renders BrokenLeaf at root, while Java emits a syntax-error page. The remaining divergence is not renderer geometry or a missing special case; it is the absence of Java's ordered command grammars and fail-closed package-opener recognition.
planned_change: Replace the unified interpretation inside ClassParser#try_package with two ordered command-shaped parses. First, for the `package` keyword, model CommandPackage exactly enough to distinguish NAME, an immediately adjacent optional `as AS`, and the complete trailing modifier region; when pre-AS stereotype text prevents that AS clause, retain NAME as identity and extract every chevron label from the one trailing capture. Second, for explicit symbol keywords, model CommandPackageWithUSymbol's display/code alternatives and keep identity-slot and trailing stereotype captures separate; select the trailing capture when present and otherwise the identity-slot capture, never concatenate them. After either complete valid parse, use the existing transactional group materialization and package_stack push unchanged. If a line starts with a supported package/symbol keyword, ends as an attempted opener, but matches neither complete grammar, return ParseError at the source line before parsing any children. Add parser tests for ordinary-command precedence, explicit-slot precedence, retained canonical parent paths, and the malformed fail-closed case. Verify all preserved follow-ups plus the fresh valid split cases; preserve the Java syntax-error negative as an executable parser-error assertion. Do not branch on fixture labels, symbol family beyond Java's command set, or rendered coordinates.

scope_boundary: This account supersedes both the earlier renderer-header explanation for the five missing groups and this account's own initial claim that all stereotype slots concatenate. The existing header-separation implementation remains relevant to clusters that survive parsing, but it cannot repair command selection, metadata ownership, or a discarded opener. This mechanism changes parser command semantics and ownership data only; any residual symbol header geometry after ownership is restored remains under class-package-style-header-separation.
